name: Legal notice
description: Finds the facts in the matter's documents, drafts a legal notice in the customary Indian form, and asks the matter lead to approve it.

inputs.label: Supporting documents (none chosen = the whole matter)
Anything else the draftsperson should know

steps.title: Draft the notice
steps.instructions: Draft a legal notice in the customary Indian form, on behalf of our client {{matter.client_name}}, addressed to {{inputs.recipient}}. The demand: {{inputs.demand}}. Allow {{inputs.deadline_days}} days to comply. Further facts from the lawyer: {{inputs.facts}}. Cite the documents for every fact you state, and use [placeholders] for anything they do not give.

steps.title: Approval before sending
steps.message: Please approve the legal notice to {{inputs.recipient}}.

steps.title: Save the notice as a draft
